The Way of Jesus · The travelling figures of Galilee

The boy Jesus, Mary, Joseph, adult Jesus and the teacher each have an original costume study with three views. An additional unobstructed wardrobe study records the side of each garment beneath the arm. These six AI-assisted paintings were created for the game. The original designs guided the fitted cloth, woven head coverings, bronze closures and color registration on the animated figures.

The visible forearms, articulated hands, legs and feet use the MakeHuman HM08 anatomy and MPFB2 rig weights under CC0. The forms were fitted to each game actor and their existing animated hands. The Caesar Sandals 1 mesh by Elvaerwyn is used under CC BY, with reshaped soles, shortened straps and new leather shading. The original face, hairline and expressions use the assets credited in the adjacent GalileeAtelier notice.
https://static.makehumancommunity.org/mpfb.html
https://www.makehumancommunity.org/node/1915

Poly Haven supplied the rough linen and brown leather material scans under CC0.
https://polyhaven.com/a/rough_linen
https://polyhaven.com/a/brown_leather

Offline measurements were made using Depth Anything V2 Small and the MediaPipe pose estimator distributed by OpenCV Zoo. Both model distributions are Apache-2.0. The source manifest identifies the precise model revisions. The Unity player uses the finished skinned meshes and garment materials.
https://huggingface.co/depth-anything/Depth-Anything-V2-Small-hf
https://github.com/opencv/opencv_zoo/tree/48b10fa505aeb51fbd127fc60a5c660040e823b7/models/pose_estimation_mediapipe
